quadrantChart
  title Reach and engagement of campaigns
  x-axis Low Reach --> High Reach
  y-axis Low Engagement --> High Engagement
  quadrant-1 We should expand
  quadrant-2 Need to promote
  quadrant-3 Re-evaluate
  quadrant-4 May be improved
  Campaign A: [0.9, 0.0] radius: 12
  Campaign B:::class1: [0.8, 0.1] color: #ff3300, radius: 10
  Campaign C: [0.7, 0.2] radius: 25, color: #00ff33, stroke-color: #10f0f0
  Campaign D: [0.6, 0.3] radius: 15, stroke-color: #00ff0f, stroke-width: 5px ,color: #ff33f0
  Campaign E:::class2: [0.5, 0.4]
  Campaign F:::class3: [0.4, 0.5] color: #0000ff
  classDef class1 color: #109060
  classDef class2 color: #908342, radius : 10, stroke-color: #310085, stroke-width: 10px
  classDef class3 color: #f00fff, radius : 10

---
config:
  quadrantChart:
    chartWidth: 400
    chartHeight: 400
  themeVariables:
    quadrant1TextFill: "ff0000"
---
quadrantChart
  x-axis Urgent --> Not Urgent
  y-axis Not Important --> "Important ❤"
  quadrant-1 Plan
  quadrant-2 Do
  quadrant-3 Delegate
  quadrant-4 Delete

quadrantChart
title Boundary and center priorities
x-axis Low urgency --> High urgency
y-axis Low impact --> High impact
quadrant-1 Prioritize
quadrant-2 Investigate
quadrant-3 Archive
quadrant-4 Delegate
Origin:::focus: [0, 0]
TopLeft: [0, 1] radius: 6, color: #4488aa
TopRight:::focus: [1, 1] radius: 10
BottomRight: [1, 0] stroke-width: 3px, stroke-color: #884422
Center:::focus: [0.5, 0.5]
NearCenter: [0.501, 0.499]
classDef focus radius: 9, color: #aa44cc, stroke-color: #224466, stroke-width: 2px

quadrantChart
title Delivery cost versus expected value
x-axis Small investment --> Large investment
y-axis Low value --> High value
quadrant-1 Fund
quadrant-2 Execute
quadrant-3 Reject
quadrant-4 Reassess
Indexing: [0.12, 0.88]
Streaming: [0.38, 0.72]
Plugins: [0.79, 0.89]
Search: [0.18, 0.42]
Sharing: [0.52, 0.51]
Collaboration: [0.88, 0.48]
Migration: [0.24, 0.14]
Themes: [0.46, 0.23]
Telemetry: [0.83, 0.17]

quadrantChart
title Styled release priorities
x-axis Short term --> Long term
y-axis Low certainty --> High certainty
quadrant-1 Commit
quadrant-2 Ship
quadrant-3 Prototype
quadrant-4 Observe
Parser:::ready: [0.15, 0.75]
Renderer:::ready: [0.35, 0.85] radius: 5
Export:::risk: [0.7, 0.2]
Review:::risk: [0.9, 0.4] color: #00aabb
classDef ready radius: 12, color: #228855, stroke-color: #113322, stroke-width: 3px
classDef risk radius: 7, color: #bb6633, stroke-color: #663311, stroke-width: 1px

quadrantChart
accTitle: 工作评估
accDescr {
  Four quadrants compare effort and benefit.
  Includes Unicode labels and three point sizes.
}
title 项目规划
x-axis 简单 --> 复杂
y-axis 低收益 --> 高收益
quadrant-1 长期计划
quadrant-2 立即实施
quadrant-3 保持观察
quadrant-4 重新评估

quadrantChart

x-axis Increasing effort -->
y-axis Confidence
quadrant-1 Explore
quadrant-3 Maintain
